certification_kind: universal analytic proof with a kernel-checked universal algebraic core

hypotheses: dq=a dx on the open unit disk
a is measurable, nonnegative and essentially bounded
there exists 0<d<1 with integral psi^2 dq <= d integral |grad psi|^2 for all psi in H^1_0
K, R and N are the exact nonnegative chain kernels from Section 4
theorem_A.conclusion: For every finite boundary family and real coefficients summing to zero, sum a_i a_j D_p(s_i,s_j)<=0, where D_p(s,t)=K(p,s)K(p,t)/N(s,t) off diagonal and zero on diagonal.

hypotheses: nu is a finite nonnegative Borel measure with compact support inside the disk
the unperturbed Green integral operator on L2(nu) has norm strictly less than 1
G(x,.) belongs to L2(nu) for every interior x
theorem_B.conclusion: Every finite interior reciprocal resolvent matrix with diagonal zero has at most one positive eigenvalue; the stated K and off-diagonal R,N evaluations are finite and their D_p kernel is conditionally negative semidefinite.
theorem_B.additional_example: nu=tau times length on [-1/2,1/2], for tau>=0 and tau*(1+log(4))/(2*pi)<1; in particular tau=1.

formal_core.statement: For every finite real PSD U, a>0, c>=0 and U_ii<a, U_ij/((1+ca)*(1+ca-cU_ij)) is PSD.
formal_core.excluded_scope: No PDE, measure, boundary-limit or full hot-spots assertion is encoded in the Lean source.
